decision: Proceed with one explicitly conditional release-bridge sensitivity test, not an accepted technical correction
provenance_limits: All770 are annotated traditional2D and have an old Broad default RNA profile, but the manuscript supplies no RNA ProfileIDs or ModelConditions.

Old default RNA metadata flags277 stranded and493 unstranded despite the historical matrix being documented unstranded. Default-profile metadata is not a demonstrated provenance map for that unstranded matrix. Do not equate these defaults to exact matrix source samples.
Matched models support empirical release differences but do not isolate processing changes; traditional-to-organoid offset transportability remains unverified.
expected_invariance: All compact and strong frozen models are linear with complete inputs. Adding a constant per feature shifts only each model intercept, preserving rankings and therefore Spearman exactly up to floating precision. This attempt can test absolute-prediction sensitivity and rule support; it cannot rescue the negative compact-versus-strong rank endpoint. No alternative scaling will be selected to create a rank improvement.
